articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a reported 3x improvement on PhD-level science benchmarks compared to GPT-4o. The model introduces a unified architecture that removes the need for separate pipelines for different modalities, simplifying deployment for enterprise customers.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored 78.4% on SWE-Bench Verified and demonstrated the ability to autonomously resolve multi-file GitHub issues across large codebases. The model leverages a new reinforcement learning from execution feedback (RLEF) pipeline that trains on real CI/CD outcomes, marking a significant step toward fully autonomous software engineering agents.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Plants
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its Figure 02 humanoid robots have entered full commercial deployment at two BMW manufacturing facilities in South Carolina, performing parts inspection, kitting, and light assembly tasks. The robots operate alongside human workers in three shifts and use onboard vision-language models for real-time task adaptation without explicit reprogramming.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Tasks in Live Demo
articles.summary: Tesla showcased the third generation of its Optimus humanoid robot performing unscripted household chores including folding laundry, loading a dishwasher, and navigating cluttered rooms. The demo highlighted a new transformer-based whole-body control policy trained end-to-end in simulation and transferred to hardware with minimal fine-tuning, though analysts remain cautious about the timeline to consumer availability.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' to Defend Against Jailbreaks at Scale
articles.summary: Anthropic published a technical paper and deployed a new safety layer called Constitutional Classifiers, which reduced successful jailbreak rates on Claude models to under 1% across adversarial red-team evaluations. The system uses a hierarchy of lightweight classifier models trained on synthetically generated attack patterns, adding minimal latency while providing defense-in-depth against prompt injection and indirect attacks.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its N1.4 process node has entered volume production at its Kaohsiung fab, roughly one quarter ahead of the originally announced schedule. The node delivers a 20% performance improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerator chips from Nvidia and AMD shipping in late 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly announced they have executed over 14,000 consecutive logical qubit operations with error rates below the fault-tolerance threshold on their hybrid ion-trap system. This milestone represents a critical step toward practical quantum error correction and brings commercially useful quantum computation meaningfully closer, particularly for materials science and cryptographic applications.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Compliance Audits of Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the EU AI Act, targeting major foundation model providers including OpenAI, Google, and Meta to assess adherence to transparency, systemic risk evaluation, and red-teaming requirements. Early reports suggest that several providers are struggling with the Act's data provenance documentation mandates, raising questions about potential fines and operational adjustments.
